title: Graph Network Learning for Human Skeleton Modeling: A Survey
core_idea: Provide a unified, systematic survey of graph network methods for human skeleton modeling, analyzing diverse learning paradigms across the entire HSM pipeline and assembling a taxonomy of techniques, benchmark datasets, application domains, and available resources.
tldr: A comprehensive overview of graph network approaches for modeling human skeletal data, organizing methods, datasets, and application areas to serve as a reference for researchers.
